title.value: DA Wand: Distortion-Aware Selection using Neural Mesh Parameterization
title.justification: The title explicitly mentions the use of neural mesh parameterization which suggests a focus on computational or design improvements rather than direct climate or ecological applications.
title.quote: DA Wand: Distortion-Aware Selection using Neural Mesh Parameterization

extractions.description: This paper introduces DA Wand, a neural technique for selecting local sub-regions on a mesh for parameterization, motivated by workflows in decaling and texturing on surfaces. It focuses on learning distortion-aware mesh segmentations using a differentiable parameterization layer, leading to efficient local parameterizations.
